title: LLM-Mini-CEX: Automatic Evaluation of Large Language Model for Diagnostic Conversation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generated medical consultation dialogues using ChatGPT as an automated judge to score the model's adherence to the LLM-specific Mini-CEX rubric, which includes a specific item (Item 2.5) assessing whether the model avoids expressing any form of bias or prejudice against certain groups of people or regional habits (e.g., regional eating habits).
